resolved_findings.title: Unresolved native child could overlap later children
resolved_findings.observation: wait_child exception left attempts null/native spawn unresolved, yet later scheduled children were started. Existing fake OSError path exercised continued starts.
resolved_findings.resolution: First unresolved helper exception sets launch_stop_reason=unresolved_native_child; every later slot is retained not_attempted with attempts=0; no retry. Fixed regression asserts one helper call, one unresolved outcome, 767 unattempted slots and all 8192 target IDs.

resolved_findings.resolution: Controller now requires frozen native A/adapter B/tree/adapter/context hashes, exact build-info hash and exact image receipt bytes; engine independently binds frozen A/B/adapter/build-info plus App/Image IDs to provider context.

resolved_findings.title: Final seal must exclude writing orphan children
